form.title: Test a VLESS link
form.description: Paste a vless:// link — probes across regions will run the speedtest and refresh the map.
form.errorNetwork: Could not enqueue the task. Try again later.
form.destinationEmpty: No targets available yet. Add one in the admin panel.

results.title: Current check
results.empty: No tasks yet. Submit a link above to run the first check.

docs.title: CheburSpeed documentation
docs.intro: CheburSpeed is a vless speedtest monitoring service. The probe is installed on a node and receives jobs over WebSocket, runs a speedtest through xray and returns the result to the server.
docs.adminIntro: All routes below are protected by JWT. Obtain a token via POST /api/v1/admin/login and pass it in the Authorization: Bearer <token> header.
docs.adminAuth: Without a token or with an expired token the server returns 401.

login.title: POST /api/v1/admin/login
login.description: Exchange email/password for a JWT. Body: { email, password }.

probes.title: GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/v1/admin/probes
probes.description: Probe CRUD. The probe token can be supplied explicitly or auto-generated.

destinations.title: GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/v1/admin/destinations
destinations.description: CRUD over speedtest target URLs. The catalogue drives the homepage dropdown and is referenced by every task.

tasks.title: GET /api/v1/admin/tasks?status=&from=&to=&region=
tasks.description: List tasks with filters and detail with per-probe results.

stats.title: GET /api/v1/admin/stats
stats.description: Dashboard aggregate: per-region medians, speed histogram, archive lag.

createTask.title: POST /api/v1/tasks
createTask.description: Create a new task. Body: { link, destination_id, probe_tokens? }.

getTask.title: GET /api/v1/tasks/{id}
getTask.description: Fetch a task with its results and destination details.

listRegions.title: GET /api/v1/regions
listRegions.description: List regions with probe_count and last_median_mbps aggregates.

onlineProbes.title: GET /api/v1/probes/online
onlineProbes.description: Per-region summary: online probes and median speed.

listDestinations.title: GET /api/v1/destinations
listDestinations.description: Public list of speedtest target URLs for the homepage dropdown.

urlParams.title: GET /?link=&destination=
urlParams.description: Homepage URL parameters: prefill the test form with the supplied link and destination.

docs.wsDescription: Probes connect to /ws with a token in the Authorization: Bearer header. After the online message the server dispatches tasks (optionally with an explicit destination_url override); the probe returns a result.

events.taskAssigned: task.assigned → probe is given a task
events.online: online → probe reports alias, region and version
events.result: result → probe returns a speed value or error

limits.createTask: POST /tasks — 10 requests per hour per IP
